english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the moment when the sun disappears below the horizon.
Use this for the sun going down or, by extension, the close of the day.
Use this specifically for the setting of the sun rather than for setting or configuring an object.

examples.english: The scenery by the sea is prettiest at sunset.
examples.traditional: 日落嗰陣，海邊啲景最靚。
examples.jyutping: jat6 lok6 go2 zan6 hoi2 bin1 di1 ging2 zeoi3 leng3

examples.english: We need to get home before the sun has set.
examples.traditional: 日落之前我哋要趕返屋企。
examples.jyutping: jat6 lok6 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gon2 faan1 uk1 kei2

examples.english: We hurried back to the hotel before the setting of the sun.
examples.traditional: 我哋趕住喺日落之前返到酒店。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gon2 zyu6 hai2 jat6 lok6 zi1 cin4 faan1 dou3 zau2 dim3
